Among them is the Fanttik S1 Pro Cordless Electric Screwdriver , which is currently matching its all-time low of $39.99 ($40 off) at Amazon for a limited time. Fanttik S1 Pro Cordless Electric Screwdriver Where to Buy: $79.99 $39.99 at Amazon $79.99 $45.99 at Fanttik Fanttik’s rechargeable tool is designed to make everyday household repairs and DIY projects easier, and it does a good job. Verge commerce editor Brandon Widder once called it his go-to electric screwdriver, noting he’s used it to assemble a bed, tighten bike seats, and perform other small- to medium-sized tasks around the house. It offers three adjustable torque settings, so you can use a gentler setting for more delicate jobs like electronics and more power for tougher projects. Beyond being a capable electric screwdriver, the Fanttik also comes equipped with a few extra conveniences. For example, it features a built-in LED light to help you see screws in darker spaces, such as under a desk or inside a cabinet. The screwdriver also comes with 16 S2 hardened steel bits, including flathead and Torx bits, all of which fit inside an included magnetic storage case.
